limitations: Original training observations; these scores do not measure held-out generalization or task success.
Support uses valid PGI contact, recorded table-normal TCP height, a stable raw feedback pair and Gemini table-height or occluded support-age state. It does not prove cup-bottom support.
Predictions are complete 50 x 7 blocks; only prefixes of three and ten points are scored at nominal 6 Hz, without robot execution or measured controller timing.
Saved fit rows retain task, camera time, tracking and timing; full RGB/state requests are checked only when embedded in the saved row.
